problem:
Find the left-sided limit at $x=0$ for the function

$$
f(x)={\begin{aligned}\operatorname{tan}⁡x & \text{ for }\,-\frac{\pi }{2}<x\le 0 \\ {log}_{2}⁡x & \text{ for }\,x>0.\end{aligned}
$$
worked_solution:
Approaching from the left, we have $x<0,$ so we use the expression $f(x)=\operatorname{tan}⁡x.$ We get

$$
\begin{aligned}{lim}_{x\to {0}^{-}}f(x) & ={lim}_{x\to {0}^{-}}\operatorname{tan}⁡x \\  & =\operatorname{tan}⁡0 \\  & =0.\end{aligned}
$$
